Medicine-On-Time 
Thonotosassa, Florida

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: My responsible are to ensure that software products meet high-quality standards before they are released to users. I work on design, implement, and execute test plans and cases to identify bugs, performance issues, and inconsistencies. I work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand project requirements, create automated and manual testing strategies, and ensure compliance with industry standards. I analyze test results, document defects, and contribute to continuous improvement processes to enhance software reliability, usability, and security.
